manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U}{R} each turn plus {5} each turn beyond the first
description:
Cast Alchemist's Gambit by paying its cleave cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Activate Mirror of Fate by tapping and sacrificing it, choosing Alchemist's Gambit and up to six other exiled cards, then exiling your library and putting the chosen cards on top of your library. Ensure Alchemist's Gambit is the top card of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Alchemist's Gambit from your library during your draw step.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Mirror of Fate from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Mirror of Fate from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.
